comment: A SubD object imported from a .3dm model (mitcad#1757, cli.import_3dm_subd: the test writer's cube net of 20 mm, a creased edge, a semi-sharp edge of sharpness 1 to 2, a corner) is an editable Form feature F1 named after the object: its cage is the file's net with the file's ids, its body a solid of one face per corner of each cage face, and a vertex moved with form.move rebuilds it.
